PerPassNoiseFloor_GiIsolate.Description: DoD part 2 — per-pass perceptual noise-floor of the GI-ISOLATE output. Metric = mean ABS per-channel pixel delta (0..255) over 7 consecutive frame pairs of the last-8-frame motion-dump window (BALLISTIC_DX12_GI_MOTION_DUMP, BALLISTIC_DX12_GI_MOTION_FRAMES=8, GI-isolate ON, frame 180 total so the temporal field is converged before the window). STATIC = resting floor (camera fixed, temporal converged). ORBIT = under camera motion (BALLISTIC_DX12_GI_ORBIT=2 deg/frame, disocclusion-driven — characterizes converge-rate, NOT the floor).
PerPassNoiseFloor_GiIsolate.Method: Run BallisticEngine.Runtime.exe DIRECTLY (bal render forces DETERMINISTIC = temporal pass-through, can't show boiling). GI-isolate via BALLISTIC_DX12_GI_ISOLATE=1.

Gate_ImgDiff.Description: §4 perceptual-diff gate for the diffuse-GI passes. Floor = resting (static, converged) boiling. The gate is floor + margin.
Gate_ImgDiff.Formula: GI-isolate frame-to-frame boiling (static, converged) must stay within max(restingFloor * 3, restingFloor + 0.2) of the frozen baseline — i.e. on this substrate, effectively 'GI-isolate boiling <= ~0.3 mean per-channel delta' for a converged static capture. A real temporal-feedback regression (history boiling, NaN-grow, leak) pushes this UP by orders of magnitude (the documented NaN-grow black-noise field, or a stuck/garbage history), far beyond 0.3 — so the loose band catches it while tolerating sub-ULP substrate noise.
Gate_ImgDiff.Margin: 3x or +0.2 (whichever looser). The resting floor is so small (0.027-0.084) that a literal k*sigma band would false-fail on any benign driver float reorder; the relative+absolute floor is the operational gate.
Gate_ImgDiff.BLIND_Note: This gate is VALID only for the GI-isolate output under a static converged camera. Under-motion boiling (5.8-17.2) is NOT a regression signal — it is the temporal converge-cost; gate the under-motion case against the frozen ORBIT baseline (re-measure post-R1.0) only, never against the resting floor.
Gate_ImgDiff.PreR1_0_ReMeasure: RE-MEASURE after R1.0 — R1.0 lights color-only/whole-mesh surfaces (more bounce hits) which changes the temporal noise characteristics; re-freeze this gate against the post-R1.0 floor before relying on it (rev7-crack-2: the re-measure rule binds BOTH the budget X AND the oracle calibration).
